profile_text.body:
The Allen Institute for AI, known as Ai2, is a nonprofit AI research laboratory founded in 2014 by Paul Allen and headquartered in Seattle, WA. The organization, currently led by Ali Farhadi, describes itself as conducting high-impact research and engineering to tackle key problems in artificial intelligence. Its work spans foundational AI research as well as applied projects in areas such as climate science, agriculture and food security, wildfire management, and wildlife protection. Ai2 describes its research as guided by open, collaborative, and inclusive principles aimed at producing safe, ethical, and trustworthy AI systems.

Ai2 develops and maintains two notable AI products tracked by this site. OLMo is an open-source large language model built with fully open training data, emphasizing research transparency consistent with the organization's nonprofit mission. Semantic Scholar is an AI-powered academic search tool offering paper summaries and citation graphs, focused on supporting the research community. The organization partners with the University of Washington's Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science and Engineering on foundational and applied research, with the NSF on an Open Multimodal AI Infrastructure project aimed at creating a national open AI ecosystem for scientific discovery, and with Google Cloud to support development of its open AI models and science-focused AI platforms.
